_comment: Worked example of the 'folder' path: local JPEGs on disk plus CSV poses, no HuggingFace. Produced by the jepa branch's run1_to_transitions.py. The pose CSV has one row per transition with the frame's own pose in x_t/y_t/yaw_t_rad, and rows are in frame order at the same rate as the images, so 'time' is omitted and row index is used for both streams.
name: spot_run1_local
